title: mitracarpus schininianus
intro: Mitracarpus schininianus, commonly known as "Baboon Hair," is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. The health benefits of Mitracarpus schininianus include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. Its therapeutic actions include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Mitracarpus schininianus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
